F33-12 ANSI device numbers on the MSC-1 generator and feeder single-line diagram
3.6 MVA / 2.88 MW generator on the 20 kV generator bus · 32 reverse power 5 % (144 kW) for 5 s · 25 synchronism check · feeder Q11 51N at 0.22 In, IEC SI, TMS 0.10 ·
• The 32 element of each 2.88 MW set trips at 5 % of rated kW, which is 144 kW, after 5 s.
• With 51N on Q11 at TMS 0.10 and twice the setting, the IEC standard inverse time is 0.1 × 0.14 / (2^0.02 − 1) = 1.003 s.
